name: Late Payment Interest
title: Late Payment Interest
text: Any undisputed amount not paid on the due date shall accrue interest from the due date until actual payment at the rate of eighteen percent (18%) per annum or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.

legal_basis.note: Interest on a sum withheld compensates the loss of its use.

legal_basis.act: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
legal_basis.note: Where the supplier is a registered MSME, compound interest at three times the RBI bank rate is payable whatever the contract says, so a contractual rate must not be presented as the ceiling.

invalid_if: The stated rate is presented as the ceiling where the supplier is a registered MSME and section 16 of the MSMED Act, 2006 imposes a higher statutory rate.
The rate is so high as to be a penalty rather than compensation for the loss of the use of money.
authoring_note: Migrated from backend/commercial/protectionLibrary.js, a second clause library that injected clauses after hardening had run. Its clauses reached shipped documents in seven document types carrying no review status, no structured legal basis and no invalid_if, and were invisible to getAllClauses(), to the unreviewed-clause ceiling, and to any knowledge-defined family. THE TEXT IS UNCHANGED by this migration, so the only difference in output is the clause id. Whether these should instead be deduplicated against their near-equivalents already in the library -- CORE_LIMITATION_LIABILITY_001, CORE_INDEMNITY_001, CORE_FORCE_MAJEURE_001 -- is a drafting decision for an advocate, not a refactor, and is deliberately left open.
